runtime: Chromium 440x680 using actual UI source/DOM, tiny synthetic File inputs, instrumented parser/converter and mocked Figma host. Does not verify real PSD parsing, real Figma rendering, OS process close, garbage collection timing or large-file memory pressure.
tests: One selected file preserves preflight, import and report while releasing decoded references
Multiple selection reads only first preflight; duplicate starts keep read/convert/host concurrency one
Multi-file drag/drop preserves every item including same-name files
Metadata preflight rejects unsupported, empty and over-limit files without reading them
A corrupted middle file fails independently and is retryable without reimporting successes
Confirmed missing-font choices and search survive next file; new missing font pauses only that item
Confirmed Auto keeps the existing host fallback and reuses the actual returned font next time
Cancel current waits for final rollback ACK before reading next file and rejects stale progress/ACK
An import ACK without terminal status reconciles and pauses; committed success survives explicit continuation
Stop all preserves committed files, cancels remaining jobs, and permits clean restart
Unconfirmed rollback locks restart, retry, clearing and next-file reads
Missing cancellation terminal ACK times out into a locked state and never pre-reads the next file
Clearing during a held preflight cannot start overlapping reads and discards late source
Page hide stops an active queue from starting another file
A pending font catalog blocks start until available mappings can be confirmed
